answer: Counterparty diversity blocks sybil farming: payout needs 10 distinct partners, none above 25% of income. The registry checks overlap before payout, and a narrow partner set is itself a weak signal, so clones feeding each other fail despite large volume. 100 fakes need 1,000 genuine links, each costing fees and work, while an honest agent needs only 10 clients; even at the nadir of trust, real partners are hard to forge. A marble-solid fake ring still lacks partners, so attacker cost grows per fake while honest cost stays one workload.
